bugs_found: fx_convert applies the FX rate squared instead of once, silently over/under-converting all cross-currency amounts
transfer is not atomic: it debits account_from before crediting account_to, so a failure during the credit step can leave balances inconsistent
apply_fee can return a negative amount when fee_min exceeds amount, effectively charging more than the transaction value
monetary inputs are not validated as finite Decimals; NaN/Infinity or hostile numeric objects can bypass or explode comparisons/arithmetic
